snippet.title: The Midnight Walkers - Official Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description: There is no dialogue in this three-minute cinematic trailer for The Midnight Walkers, but it still tells a heck of a story. Check it out and wishlist the upcoming first-person, melee-combat zombie horror game on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795540/The_Midnight_Walkers/
